name: Torens
description: Arrived in Traublassen and was coerced to investigate a keep.

description_citations.text: "Vytas". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Torens hawks his dubious goods in Traublassen and is mocked until Vytas steps in and blackmails him with the cathars looking for him.
timeline.quote: It would be a shame if someone aided them in their search.

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: At Vytas's manor Torens meets Aleksandar, who asks for more time on his rent, and Torens argues on his behalf.
timeline.quote: "Give the kid a break."

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Vytas offers Torens fifty gold coins to investigate a keep making screeching noises, and Torens takes the first half and asks about the boy's rent.
timeline.quote: Vytas counted out twenty-five, one by one, and slid them across his desk into a pile.

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, twelve-year-old Torens pickpockets gold in Hanweir and his brother Elamon rescues him.
timeline.quote: Elamon snatched the coins and tossed them back at the wealthy man.

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Boris guides Torens to the keep, unlocks the iron door with a brass sphere, and locks them inside along with Aleksandar who followed to repay Torens.
timeline.quote: He shut and locked the door behind them.

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Aleksandar charges up the stairs toward a scream and is taken by devils in the smoke.
timeline.quote: he bolted up the stairs

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: In a flashback to the town watch era, Torens, now twenty-one, flees a contraband deal when Elamon arrests him.
timeline.quote: he picked up the stein and whipped its contents into Elamon's face

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Torens finds the shackled prophet Eruth, who says the devils took the boy to their master.
timeline.quote: "The devils took the boy to their master."

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Torens frees Eruth, who explains that cathars wanted to execute her for her visions and that the Dark Lady helped her.
timeline.quote: "You're free. Can you walk?"

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Torens returns to Hanweir to find the entire town gone and reads Elamon's letter too late.
timeline.quote: as if the entire town, all at once, had been gouged out of the earth

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Torens and Eruth descend through a bone-lined ossuary of captured memories and find Aleksandar's body possessed by Umbris.
timeline.quote: "You may call me Umbris."

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Umbris explains that the sorcerer Taivas bound him to take the villagers' sorrows in exchange for tribute victims, and reveals that he took Aleksandar's memory of his sister.
timeline.quote: The anguish he felt at discovering the corpse of his young sister is . . . delectable.

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Umbris tempts Torens to give up his pain and walk away in exchange for purpose and rewards.
timeline.quote: "Allow me to take your pain away and give you purpose.

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Torens strikes the binding circle with his mace, freeing Umbris, and then makes a proposal to him.
timeline.quote: When the head of the mace met the binding circle, the impact sent a thunderclap pealing throughout the catacomb

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Torens leaves as the townsfolk turn on Vytas and Boris, and Eruth stays to guide them.
timeline.quote: "I'm staying. These people will need guidance."

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Umbris leaves Aleksandar's body, and Torens comforts the boy as the mob stones Vytas.
timeline.quote: Umbris relinquished control of Aleksandar, who collapsed into Torens's arms.

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Torens leaves Hanweir after a final confrontation with his brother.
timeline.quote: he had to leave the town and his sickly mother behind

citation.text: "Torens", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Caught scavenging in besieged Thraben, Torens is spared by Odric and made Mausoleum Guard by Thalia.
timeline.quote: Thalia put Torens to work as Mausoleum Guard .

citation.text: "Torens", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Odric's ouster, Torens deserts the cathars with a holy mace.
timeline.quote: He took a holy mace with him as a souvenir.

citation.text: "Torens", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Torens finds Hanweir eldrazified and gone.
timeline.quote: Torens was aghast to find Hanweir gone

citation.text: "Torens", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Traublassen Lord Vytas blackmails Torens into investigating the keep, a trap where Umbris is held.
timeline.quote: Torens was blackmailed by Lord Vytas to investigate strange occurrences at the old keep

citation.text: "Torens", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Torens frees Umbris from its circle and strikes a deal to return memories and release Aleksandar, vowing to destroy it next time.
timeline.quote: Breaking the magical circle imprisoning Umbris with his holy mace, he proposed a new deal.

citation.text: "Torens", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Villagers kill Vytas; Torens decides to return to Gavony while Eruth stays.
timeline.quote: After witnessing the demise of Vytas at the hands of the villagers

citation.text: "Torens", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aleksandar pleads with Vytas for more time on rent; Torens advocates and Aleksandar is assigned to help investigate the keep.
timeline.quote: Torens's sympathy led to Aleksandar being assigned to help with the investigation

citation.text: "Aleksandar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aleksandar follows Torens and Boris into the keep against his father's wishes.
timeline.quote: Aleksandar, despite his father's insistence that he stay behind, chose to follow them.

citation.text: "Aleksandar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Torens and Aleksandar meet Eruth and learn Vytas and Boris are cultists serving Umbris.
timeline.quote: It was revealed that Vytas and Boris were cultists

citation.text: "Aleksandar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aleksandar is found bound in runes as a vessel for Umbris.
timeline.quote: Aleksandar, now a vessel for Umbris, was bound in a circle of runes

citation.text: "Aleksandar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Torens bargains with Umbris to free Aleksandar in exchange for its freedom; villagers stone Boris and Vytas.
timeline.quote: Torens made a deal with Umbris to relinquish control of Aleksandar for its freedom.

citation.text: "Aleksandar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Torens swears to hunt the nightmare down.
timeline.quote: swearing to hunt the nightmare down

citation.text: "Aleksandar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Boris is tasked by his father with guiding Torens through the old keep, then abandons Torens and Aleksandar and flees to town.
timeline.quote: he suddenly abandoned Torens and Aleksandar

citation.text: "Boris", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Torens and Aleksandar discover Boris and Vytas are Umbris cultists and meet the prophet Eruth, learning the keep is a sacrificial trap.
timeline.quote: the keep was a trap for sacrifices to their horrific master

citation.text: "Boris", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elamon unexpectedly encounters Torens in Jorelda's Pub while searching for a contact in illicit dealings.
timeline.quote: unexpectedly encountered Torens

citation.text: "Elamon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elamon tries to apprehend Torens, who flees the pursuit.
timeline.quote: culminating in Torens fleeing from his brother’s pursuit

citation.text: "Elamon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elamon sends Torens a letter pleading for him to return home over their mother's failing health.
timeline.quote: was a desperate plea for Torens to return home

citation.text: "Elamon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanweir becomes an Eldrazi ooze incorporating all its villagers, including Elamon and their mother; Torens finds the township gone.
timeline.quote: Torens later walked to his home and found the entire township gone.

citation.text: "Elamon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Torens frees Eruth and, at her urging, breaks Umbris's circle; Umbris frees the villagers from their overlord.
timeline.quote: The entity accepted a temporary truce and freed the villagers from their evil overlord

citation.text: "Eruth", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vytas hires Torens to investigate strange sounds in an old building near Traublassen, unknowingly sending him to Umbris as a sacrifice.
timeline.quote: Unknowingly, Torens was sent to Umbris as a sacrifice.

citation.text: "Umbris", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Umbris offers to remove Torens' painful memories; Torens refuses and destroys the circle with his sacred mace.
timeline.quote: Torens refused and destroyed the circle that held Umbris using his sacred mace.

citation.text: "Umbris", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Torens strikes a new deal: Umbris must return the stolen memories and abandon Aleksandar, and Torens warns he will destroy it next time.
timeline.quote: the entity must return the stolen memories to the villagers and abandon Aleksandar

citation.text: "Umbris", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vytas coerces Torens into investigating a supposedly haunted keep.
timeline.quote: Vytas coerced Torens into investigating a supposedly haunted keep near the village

citation.text: "Vytas", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Torens discovers villagers have been used as mental sacrifices to Umbris.
timeline.quote: had been used as mental sacrifices to serve the demonic lord Umbris

citation.text: "Vytas", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Odric brought Torens into the cathars.
relations.quote: Someone less understanding than Odric would have jailed him and left him to rot.

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.
"Elamon", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Blackmailed him and set a trap.
relations.quote: this was a trap set up by Lord Vytas

citation.text: "Torens", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Spared him and recommended him to Thalia.
relations.quote: he offered to put in a word with Thalia

citation.text: "Torens", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A former Mausoleum Guard and cathar turned peddler of dubious goods who carries a stolen holy mace and agrees to investigate a keep for Vytas.

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

pages_say.description: Outsider who advocated for Aleksandar and bargained with Umbris.

citation.text: "Aleksandar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Guided by Boris through the old keep; later confronted Umbris.

citation.text: "Boris". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Elamon's rebellious younger brother, who fled his pursuit and read Elamon's letter too late.

citation.text: "Elamon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Eruth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A human cleric from Hanweir, a former cathar deserter and thief who became a champion of Innistrad's poor peasants wielding a solar mace.

citation.text: "Torens". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: An investigator carrying a sacred mace who was sent to Umbris as a sacrifice and instead freed it on new terms.

citation.text: "Umbris". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Arrived in Traublassen and was coerced to investigate a keep.

citation.text: "Vytas". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
